title: Russia's Kosmos 2542 and Kosmos 2543 approaching U.S. reconnaissance satellite
status: Development reconstruction; supported windows are narrower than the historical episode

windows.label: December 7 · observer window
windows.chapterNarrative: A dated USA 245 observer element supports a short reconstruction with Kosmos 2542.
windows.note: USA 245 has a nearby amateur-derived element. Kosmos 2542's element is within the 36-hour display gate but older than the 12-hour statistics gate.

windows.label: December 8 · observer window
windows.chapterNarrative: A second USA 245 observer element supports a separate short view with Kosmos 2542.
windows.note: The December 8 USA 245 element supports this separate reconstruction. No track crosses the gap from December 7.

windows.label: December 31 · dated elements
windows.chapterNarrative: Dated elements support a short reconstruction of Kosmos 2542 and USA 245.
windows.note: Both plotted spacecraft have nearby dated elements. USA 245's element is roughly 8–10 hours from this window; this geometry does not establish a measured close approach.
